node.statement: For every row index i, g_i=(P*1_{G_a})_i=sum_{j in G_a} P_ij<=sum_{j in G_a} P_ij^+. Splitting 1=L_j+U_j in each positive coefficient gives sum_{j in G_a} P_ij^+=M_i^a+sum_{j in G_a} P_ij^+ L_j, where M_i^a=sum_{j in G_a} P_ij^+ U_j. Multiplying the bound on L_j by P_ij^+>=0 and summing over j in G_a yields g_i<=M_i^a+sum_{j in G_a} P_ij^+*(H-d_j)/(H-a*tau), and the first step proves that M_i^a is positive mass supported entirely on hidden row vertices at depth in (a*tau,H].
